title: Cosmic Guardians with Dog
description: A hooded figure in glowing blue futuristic armor stands on a shattered platform facing a woman in a white bodysuit who holds a small brown and white dog. They are positioned in front of a massive, intricate glowing circular rune floating in a vibrant cosmic nebula of purple, blue and pink.
